Welcome to Bloom Dental, your trusted dentist in Muncie, IN, providing high-quality, personalized dental care for individuals and families. Conveniently located on W McGalliard Rd, our practice offers comprehensive general dentistry, cosmetic dentistry, and emergency dental services designed to meet the needs of the Muncie community. Whether you’re visiting us for a routine dental cleaning or a complete smile makeover, our experienced team is here to help you achieve excellent oral health and a confident smile.

Whether you’re looking for a family dentist in Muncie, a cosmetic dentist, routine preventive care, or urgent dental treatment near W McGalliard Rd, we deliver compassionate, results-driven care you can rely on.

Our Muncie dental office is equipped with advanced dental technology to provide accurate, efficient, and comfortable care. From modern treatment rooms to patient-focused amenities, we’ve designed our office with your comfort in mind. We also follow strict sterilization and safety protocols to ensure a clean, safe environment for every visit.

Bloom Dental is conveniently located at 1003 W McGalliard Rd, Muncie, IN 47303, making it easy to access from Ball State University, nearby neighborhoods, shopping centers, and major roadways. With flexible scheduling options, extended hours, and easy online appointment booking, quality dental care fits seamlessly into your daily routine.

At Bloom Dental Muncie, we’re more than just a dental office — we’re your partners in lifelong oral health. Schedule your appointment online or call today to experience trusted, patient-centered care from a leading Muncie dentist dedicated to your comfort, convenience, and smile.

At Bloom Dental, we believe every smile deserves personalized care at every stage of life. From prevention to advanced treatments, our comprehensive services are designed to keep your teeth healthy, functional, and beautiful.

Dr. Whybrew is a general dentist dedicated to preventive care, personalized treatment, and building lasting trust with patients. She believes dentistry is about more than teeth—it’s about listening, education, and helping every patient feel confident in their smile.

Dr. Katelyn Brown-Minor earned degrees in Biochemistry and Spanish from IU East before completing her Doctor of Dental Surgery at the IU School of Dentistry. She is passionate about service and reducing barriers to care, and she strives to create a comfortable, supportive environment—especially for patients with dental anxiety.

Dr. Childers is a Muncie native and experienced dentist committed to high-quality, patient-centered care. He earned his dental degree from Midwestern University after completing undergraduate and graduate studies at Ball State University. Dr. Childers provides a wide range of treatments—from routine fillings to crowns, bridges, and advanced implant dentistry, including All-on-Four. He focuses on helping patients feel comfortable, informed, and confident at every visit.

Dr. Lungu is a dentist with a strong passion for oral surgery, with a particular focus on wisdom teeth removals and dental implants. He takes pride in guiding patients through procedures that often cause anxiety, making every effort to ensure they feel comfortable, informed, and at ease throughout their entire visit. For Dr. Lungu, there is nothing more rewarding than transforming a stressful dental experience into a positive one and helping patients leave feeling relieved and confident.

Comprehensive Care for Every Smile

At Bloom Dental, we believe every smile deserves personalized care at every stage of life. From prevention to advanced treatments, our comprehensive services are designed to keep your teeth healthy, functional, and beautiful.

Emergency Dentistry
Dental emergencies can happen unexpectedly and cause pain and injury to your teeth. We are here to provide emergency dentistry services and restore your smile as quickly as possible.
Learn more
Pediatric Dentistry
Receiving high-quality dental treatment is just as important for children as it is for adults. We take great pride in helping our younger patients achieve excellent oral health and pediatric dental services in the community.
Learn more
Root Canal Treatment
Root canal treatment can save an infected tooth from otherwise certain extraction—it’s a proven procedure that will leave your mouth healthy and strong while restoring its natural appearance.
Learn more
Dental Implants
Dental implants are a reliable and permanent solution for tooth replacement, offering natural function and appearance.
Learn more
Dental Veneers
Dental veneers provide an excellent solution if you are looking to enhance your smile. They are a popular cosmetic treatment because of their overall effectiveness and ease of use.
Learn more
Teeth Whitening
You deserve bright, white teeth in your smile. Our teeth whitening treatments will help you achieve just that—so you can feel confident in your tooth coloring.
Learn more
